She wouldn't tell anyone about her deal with Zhao An, pretending she didn't know him. It wasn't that she didn't trust Tang Bing, but now there was no one in the Tang family she could trust.

For them to call each other "brothers" proved their relationship had reached a point of irreconcilability. Even brothers were beginning to settle scores.

Tang Bing didn't immediately hand over the technical information. Instead, he bit into his cigar, looking like a scoundrel. "You want to teach me how to do things? Just give it to me when you say so?"

"Zhao An, go find him. The boss of Future Group. Go find him. If you want to kill him, remember to come back and tell me. Thank you." Tang Bing wouldn't forget his hatred for Zhao An. This hatred was very real. As long as Zhao An remained strong, he would be more obedient than any dog. That was the reality.
Bang! Tang Bing slammed the table, appearing extremely angry. "Heir? Do you consider me one? Don't give me that shit. You want technology, there's no way I'm going to give it to you!"

After looking around the office, Tang Wu sat down in front of Tang Bing. "Brother, your decor is quite unique. To be honest, I'm here on the orders of the family. "I've always treated Big Brother like an idol. Since Big Brother doesn't want to hand over his technology, I'll ask where it comes from. That's fine, right?" Tang Wu asked with a smile, without a trace of embarrassment or hesitation. He's already quite the face-sitter.

"Brother, it's been a while since we last met. You didn't even come to see me when you came here. Don't you think of me as your brother anymore? Haha, you're in such a good mood today, even drinking in the office." Tang Wu acted familiarly, without a hint of unfamiliarity.

Tang Bing didn't express any opinion, merely nodded and said, "If Young Master An attacks the Shanxing Group, I can certainly help. Do you think the family will learn of Young Master An's technical secrets? If they proactively send someone to negotiate, then your chances of getting you there are very high."

paragraphs: The two sat down. Lu Jun made the first move, offering a tea invitation. "Have some tea, you're welcome."
"Thank you, Minister Lu." Zhao An was unfazed. "Have some tea!"

As for continuing his family line? A daughter would be enough. Once he had reached a high enough level, he could then consider finding a lover, having a son, or anything like that. There was no need for that now, and no reason for that.
Sun Yue also smiled and extended her hand to shake hands. "Haha, Xiao An is really good at talking. Auntie's old now. Please sit down. It's time to eat. Let's try Auntie's cooking."

"It's already a virtuous cycle: merchants earn more, and consumers enjoy more. Competition is indeed more intense, but there are also more opportunities, and starting a business is easier. The platform's growth and strength are a good thing." The difficulties they face are increasing. I think Uncle Lu could issue a statement suggesting that restaurants regulate their practices and prohibit the sale of inferior goods as genuine. After all, takeout is invisible, so who knows what's inside.

"Oh, hello, Aunt Sun. You're so well-maintained. If Meifang hadn't told me, I would have thought you were her sister. Nice to meet you, nice to see you." Zhao An made an exaggerated expression and extended his hand to shake hers.

"This herbal cigarette is a blend of nourishing herbs like angelica, wolfberry, and ginseng, processed using a unique process to create this finished product. It eliminates the harmful effects of smoking and is refreshing without any side effects. If there's a drawback, it's the higher cost." Zhao An lit the cigarette and blew out a puff of smoke.

"One cigarette costs 100,000 yuan," Zhao An said with a playful smile. It was indeed true. That was the retail price. As for the cost, aside from the technical patents, the materials would only cost a few hundred or a few thousand yuan. Better medicinal herbs would naturally be more expensive; it was up to him to decide.
"Oh? How expensive is it?" Lu Jun had already confirmed Zhao An's relationship with his daughter. He'd come here to get Zhao An to express his feelings, to see if he was sincere.
The rise of food delivery platforms was definitely problematic, with both risks and rewards. If he wanted to advance further, he had to gain some experience from it.

Lu Jun raised his eyelids and lit a cigarette with a hint of skepticism. The rich aroma of Chinese herbs filled his mind, and the words "refreshing and refreshing" instantly popped into his mind. This was indeed a very good cigarette, very good. "Very good cigarettes, indeed. You young people still rule the roost these days. The creativity and innovation are fantastic."
Lu Jun picked up the cigarette with some confusion and sniffed it. It had a hint of Chinese herbal medicine. "What kind of cigarette is this?"
The beautiful woman carrying the dish smiled slightly, her hand on her forehead. "Zhao An is quite humorous."
"This is my mother, Sun Yue," Lu Meifang explained from the back.
Taste? Savoring her voluptuous body is more appropriate. Having sex with a beautiful woman in a high position is the most pleasurable and fulfilling thing.

"Haha, then I won't be polite, Uncle Lu. It's the end of the year, do you need to stay on duty?" Zhao An took a sip from his teacup. Lu Jun was the head of the office. His power was both great and small. It all came down to how well he aligned himself.

"We absolutely must not engage in such practices that infringe on consumer interests when dealing with unscrupulous businesses. Regulating market order and creating a civilized and positive urban environment—it's all worth it, isn't it?" Zhao An held out a cigarette. "Here, Uncle Lu, try this one. I custom-made it. There's only one of its kind in the world." Zhao An's expression was smug, incredibly proud.
Zhao An has a good grasp of his inner darkness. He won't share his secrets with others until the time is right. Just like his incest with his mother, he can't tell anyone else.

Don't assume that being on the same side means peace and harmony. It's perfectly normal for members of the same side to fight. It could be due to a lack of familiarity, dislike, or a fight for male dignity. Fighting isn't limited to opposing factions.

"Well, no need to be so polite. You and Meifang are classmates. I'm being generous, just call me uncle." Lu Jun was a man of observation and had no complaints about Zhao An. While he had connections, he also took sides. But the advantage of having a daughter was that he could find a good son-in-law, which would help him advance further.

"Haha, it's just a small amount of money. I personally don't have much of an idea about money. Having money can be both a good thing and a bad thing. Every day when I open my eyes, the first thing I think about is how I'm going to spend it. It's a pain, something that leaves me incredibly confused." Zhao An's expression was resigned, a bit of a cocky boast.
"Okay, then I must try it today. Just the smell of this aroma is making my mouth water." Zhao An laughed heartily. "Uncle Lu, please, please take a seat."

The few of them sat down, and Zhao An took a few bites. He had to admit that Sun Yue was a real cook. The food was delicious. She was beautiful, and she was a good cook. She was the epitome of a good homemaker.

"I'll tell Meifang if I need anything, and of course, Uncle Lu's help is indispensable. The platform's current focus is to continue making money, first earning back the capital. I've invested nearly five billion yuan this time. Since we've established a foothold in the local restaurant industry, their turnover has increased by at least 20%, their profits have increased, and consumers have become more convenient."

"It's necessary. Sometimes it takes a little time. While I'm still strong, it's good to do more. I recently heard from Meifang that you're planning further expansion on the Haotuan platform. It seems you're truly adept at business. If you need any help, please let Uncle Lu know. As long as it's within my responsibilities, I'm committed to serving the people!" Lu Jun's expression grew serious.
"Eat, Xiao An. Eat more if you like. I don't know what you like, so don't mind if the food is not tasty." Sun Yue greeted him with the aura of a hostess.

paragraphs: "This is the work of a renowned chef. I envy Uncle Lu so much! Not only does he have such a beautiful wife, but he also gets to enjoy such delicious meals every day. I think life couldn't be more fulfilling than this: a happy family and a successful career." Zhao An laughed heartily, his compliments pleasing to the eye, without the slightest hint of flattery.

"Haha, your Uncle Lu is busy with work, Xiao An. If you'd like, you can come back with Meifang for dinner often. Auntie will definitely make delicious food for you." Sun Yue's face still wore a hint of a smile, but her tone was slightly dissatisfied, as if she was somewhat dissatisfied with her husband.
"I don't think she needs any cosmetics. Uncle is the best," Zhao An laughed heartily, even half-jokingly telling a dirty joke.
"Haha, it seems Xiao An really knows how to live life." Sun Yue's lips curled with a smile, not sure if it was a compliment or a taunt from her mount.
Lu Jun's expression changed. Was he planning to make his daughter his mistress? "Xiao An, I'd like to ask who your family is?"
Lu Jun's expression remained unchanged, but Sun Yue quipped, "You're quite the talker, haha. Your uncle's very busy, a real busy man."

"I'll definitely come when I have the chance. I'm just worried that if the group grows bigger, I'll have less time. I think life is short, so we should enjoy it while we can. Making money is just for the sake of having more to spend." Zhao An smiled as he expressed his view: when you have money, you should enjoy it while you can.

"Shouldn't a man also prioritize his career? Especially with a wife like Auntie as your supporter, if he doesn't work hard now, when will he? Ambition is a good thing. If it weren't for Auntie's support, why would Uncle work so hard? And hard work doesn't go without reward. Maybe he'll get a promotion someday." Zhao An smiled and nibbled on a piece of fresh fruit.
Just then, Sun Yue came over with a fruit plate. "Have some fruit. Xiao An, Xiaofang said you're planning to start a cosmetics business. What kind of cosmetics do you think Auntie should use?"

"Auntie, you can go to the gym. I opened a beauty salon. It's a place for my company's female employees to get beautify themselves, and it's kind of a benefit. Recently, a friend asked to use my space, saying that wives and mothers need a safe place, and they thought of my beauty salon. It offers beauty treatments, a professional yoga studio for staying in shape, a heated swimming pool, and a sports field."
Lu Meifang rolled her eyes, unsure whether to say it. Why bother saying it? It was just keeping people on edge!
"Huh? We're all family, so there's no need to lie, right?" Lu Jun said with a hint of dissatisfaction. What a joke! Who would believe Zhao An was a self-made man?

Just as Lu Jun was about to say something, Zhao An said, "Auntie, you're probably bored at home. I do have a suggestion, but it might have a little impact on Uncle, and I'm not sure if I should say it."

"After the New Year, it's time for a change of leadership. The top leader has been promoted. You know that, right?" Lu Jun began to discuss some internal matters. Now that it was confirmed, they had to discuss the 'dowry.'" "I know, but I'm not interested in any of that. Uncle Lu, I'm not interested in getting married right now, but as long as Senior Meifang stays with me, I'll definitely treat her well. I don't like making promises I can't keep, and I'm too lazy to say or won't say anything I can't do." Zhao An was making his stance clear.

Lu Jun remained silent. He knew his wife was beautiful and virtuous. But some things couldn't be undone simply because he wanted to. Some things, once done, could never be undone. "Haha, then Xiao An, you can come here more often and treat this place like your home. You're welcome!"

"Xiao An, I don't want you to just play with my daughter, Xiao Fang. No father would let his daughter become a plaything. You understand what I mean, right?" Lu Jun poured Zhao An a cup of tea, his expression serious.

"You say it. It doesn't matter. We're all family." Lu Jun made his point clear. If things could go further, he wouldn't mind his daughter being with him. And if he wanted to go back on his word later, he'd have to consider his status.

"Hmph, can you be busy all year long?" Sun Yue snorted, a hint of dissatisfaction. This was due to her unsatisfied sex life, as she entered middle age. Women have higher libidos, while men have lower ones. This is an eternal truth.
After eating and drinking, Lu Meifang joined Sun Yue in clearing the dishes. The two grown men continued to sip tea in the living room, seemingly getting down to business.
"No, I started from scratch," Zhao An said flatly. He really wasn't from a wealthy family.

"I know. I've never been one for fun. It's pointless. I have no interest in prostitution. I only do things I'm sure of. I'm not interested in anything else." Zhao An was telling the truth; there was no need to lie. He didn't like prostitution. That was a fact. He preferred keeping mistresses to prostitution. Using a public vehicle for personal purposes, and even having children—isn't that fun?

This made Sun Yue's eyes light up. She was rich and powerful, but her life felt a little empty and lonely. She longed for a normal family life, but her husband often didn't come home. When he did, he worked and slept in the study. He claimed to be busy with work, but every time Sun Yue looked even slightly seductive in her cheongsam, her husband would flee in panic, and she was genuinely annoyed.

Sun Yue was also a little puzzled, her beautiful eyes narrowed. She felt her daughter's boyfriend wasn't going to be easy to deal with. He looked so smiling, but he was either a naive person or a smiling tiger. Which one was he?
"Busy with career and neglecting family? How can you strive like that?" Sun Yue complained, her tone a little resentful.
"It's the end of the year now, aren't you busy?" Lu Jun could only explain that with the recent leadership changes and personnel changes, he needed to be on the move frequently.

"This is specifically for women. Originally, it was a benefit, but navigating society requires a certain level of social interaction. Especially for businesspeople like me, I've started semi-publicly recruiting members. So, if you're not bothered, you can go to the beauty salon to relax," Zhao An said with a smile.
